title: Demo: A quieter kind of AI briefing
subject: A small model, a useful workflow, and a better question
intro: This fictional demo edition shows how Signal Daily turns a few source notes into a readable briefing. The names, events, and source links below are synthetic examples, not news reporting.

items.headline: A small-model experiment puts clarity first
items.summary: In this fictional example, a research team shares a compact model and a short evaluation notebook. Their demonstration focuses on explaining limitations alongside useful results.
items.why: A clear evaluation helps readers decide what to test, rather than treating a model announcement as a promise.
items.source_title: Synthetic source note: a compact-model experiment
items.source_description: Fictional fixture: a team shares a small model, an evaluation notebook, and a description of limitations.

items.headline: An assistant workflow keeps the editor in control
items.summary: A fictional product team connects a drafting assistant to a review checklist. The assistant suggests text, while an editor checks sources and makes the publication decision.
items.why: Useful automation can shorten preparation while keeping a person's judgment at the point of publication.
items.source_title: Synthetic source note: a review-first assistant
items.source_description: Fictional fixture: drafting suggestions are saved for an editor to check before publication.

items.headline: Better questions make a better evaluation
items.summary: A fictional community workshop compares assistants on ordinary tasks. Participants record failures and explain the context behind each result instead of announcing a universal winner.
items.why: Context makes a comparison more useful to readers choosing tools for their own work.
items.source_description: Fictional fixture: a workshop compares assistants, records failures, and describes task context.

closing: Good briefings leave room for judgment. This entire edition is synthetic demo content, written to demonstrate the interface; it was not generated from real news.
